'''Morrax Nabin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and avid [[Holochess/Legends|holochess]] player who served as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Nabin attended a gala on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to mark the launch of a new [[Gem of Alderaan|luxury hovertrain]]. After the [[Train/Legends|train]] was [[Battle of the Gem of Alderaan|attacked]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], Nabin sheltered in the [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain's]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] car with his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] bodyguards.

==Biography==
Morrax Nabin was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who, having reached an advanced age, served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Governor/Legends|governor]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Nabin had a penchant for [[Holochess/Legends|holochess]] and on occasion played the Imperial leader [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the game.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> Circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Echoes of the Jedi]],'' the fourth instalment of the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign, states that the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]] two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. This thus indicates that ''Dawn of Defiance'' is set in circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].</ref> Nabin was among over one hundred members of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] elite invited to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] for the maiden journey of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]''. Nabin attended a lavish opening party held at a [[Train station/Legends|hoverstation]]<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]]<ref name="Primer">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/dodcampaign|text=''Dawn of Defiance'': Gamemaster Primer}}</ref> and journeyed on the [[Train/Legends|train]] as it departed on a six [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] trip. Nabin was accompanied to the event by a detail of elite [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] bodyguards that escorted him everywhere throughout the excursion.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />

{{RPG|''[[The Gem of Alderaan]]''}}
In hope that someone would join him for a game, Nabin took up a spot at a holochess board in the train's lounge car. While he waited, the governor supped on [[Alderaanian brandy]] and conversed with the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] executive [[Dien Suub]] and several the other guests, discussing subjects ranging from history to politics and financial markets. Eventually, Nabin was challenged at holochess by one of several [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents that had infiltrated the event posing as [[Aide/Legends|aides]] of the Imperial [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]. The governor was defeated in the game and he felt favorably toward his chess opponent as a result. Nabin also ventured to the hovertrain's restaurant car and attended a banquet where he enjoyed some fine dining. While he ate, he conversed with the rebel agents regarding the quality of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] on offer.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />

The ''Gem of Alderaan'' fell [[Battle of the Gem of Alderaan|under assault]] from [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that sought to capture Bail Organa and incorrectly believed the senator to be traveling on the train. Nabin suffered minor injuries in the attack and took shelter in the train's [[Casino/Legends|casino]] car, where his stormtrooper guards repelled several Trandoshan attackers and an [[SD-6 Hulk infantry droid|SD-6 "Hulk" infantry droid]] with assistance from the Alderaanian Resistance operatives. The mercenaries were driven from the casino and, convinced by the agents' credentials as aides of Bail Organa, Nabin temporarily transferred command of his stormtroopers to the group. The rebels and the stormtroopers then forced the Trandoshans from the rest of the hovertrain.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Nabin had [[Color/Legends|graying]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a moustache. He was introverted and had a love for holochess; he enjoyed simultaneously engaging multiple Imperial colleagues of his in holochess matches, playing against them remotely, sharing over a matter of [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] details of his next moves in the game. When engaging in a game of holochess, he felt intimidated if has opponent made their moves in the game particularly rapidly. During the raid on the ''Gem of Alderaan'' by the Trandoshan mercenaries, Nabin felt shaken by the attack and wanted his stormtrooper security detail to remain by his side to protect him.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Morrax Nabin appeared within ''[[The Gem of Alderaan]]'' a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] module set with [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity by [[Gary M. Sarli]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[February 5]] [[2009]] as the eight adventure in [[Wizards of the Coast]]s' ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' roleplaying campaign.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />

In the adventure, the players roleplay as the Alderaanian Resistance agents that infiltrate the ''Gem of Alderaan'' hovertrain and the players attempt to gain the favor of Nabin and the other major guests at the launch party so as to gain the attention of the event's patron, [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Alya Aldrete]]. The players can improve Nabin's level of goodwill toward them by defeating him at holochess and by engaging him in refined conversation in the train's dining car. After the train is attacked by Trandoshan raiders, the players attempt to convince Nabin to let them take charge of the governor's stormtrooper detail. If sucessfully persuaded, Nabin agrees to release his guards to assist the rebel agents. It is alternately possible for Nabin to decline to release his bodyguards to the rebels' command but to instead share with them weapons and equipment, or for Nabin to refuse to aid the player characters at all, in which case he retreats to the hovertrain's [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] [[Decadence nightclub|Decadence]] with his stormtroopers.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />
